summary: CTO Realty Growth filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026 disclosing an Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with KeyBank as administrative agent, replacing the September 30, 2024 facility. The package provides a $400 million senior unsecured revolver maturing September 2030 with two six-month extensions, plus four $150 million unsecured term loans maturing 2029, 2030, 2031, and March 2032. Aggregate commitments can increase to $1.5 billion. This is a routine credit-facility refinancing, not a special situation; watch pricing grids and covenant headroom.
